nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Quick Calming Pad

avis.texte: These pads are simply wonderful to reduce redness, itching, inflammation and anything happening on my combination skin. I love to leave them on my skin for 15-20 minutes before heading out and my skin looks and feels refreshed and shiny.
Great formulation but frustratingly flimsy pads that bunch up; very annoying. I don't recommend these pads.
This product is amazing!!! It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and fresh. I love to learn is soak then scrub my face with it. Will be purchasing more products 🩷

avis.titre: If you're thinking about it, this is me telling you to get!
avis.texte: This is one of those products you'll wish you tried sooner. It's very gentle, effective, and delivers real result immediately.

I never used pads like this before, but these changed my mind! It is like a mini face mask. I put two on my face and let it sit. It leaves my face hydrated, and refreshed even until the morning. I've been using the pads for over a year, and it's been a staple for me!! Can't be without it now!!!

The packaging is genius - there is a top compartment separate from the pads that can hold a tweezer, so your hands and pads don't get dirty. However, the pads were just ok for my skin. It is not as soothing but would probably work for normal skin.

I enjoyed how easy they were to use! It's an amazing experience where you open it and it has these tweezers to pick up the pads and you put it on your skin. I have a lot of flare ups especially with my rosacea and this helps it stayed hydrated and calms my skin when it's red. It makes me feel confident and beautiful
The first thing that I love about this product is that it's scent free! When you first use this product, you will instantly notice how hydrating it really is. It leaves your skin feeling amazing.

I would use this product in my daily routine after my cleanse. I truly noticed a difference in the areas that tend to have more inflammation. The pads feel so smooth and soft on your face and the serum on the pads is so cooling and refreshing. I look forward to rubbing these on my face every morning. Also, for my fragrance sensitive people, there is little to no scent at all.

This was my first time using this product as well as any item from this brand. I found it to be cooling and refreshing. I flung them Easy to use and convenient. Very easy to toss on while getting ready for the day or bed
I love how this smells and feels. It doesn't leave residue on skin and leaves it so soft and bright

These pads are very thin but hydrating. They stay on the skin very well and are not at all uncomfortable to wear around the house. They stay hydrated for a while and deliver amazing ingredients, leaving your skin looking plump. I love to use this as makeup skin prep as well!
I used this product for about a week and it did wonders for my skin! It left me hydrating and glowy. I couldn't recommend this enough!

avis.titre: Refreshing addition to my skin care routine
avis.texte: These toner pads are very calming and gentle. Easy to use and the shape makes for easy for on face around eyes. I loved the packaging feels lux and the pads even feel very nice too. They have a nice calm smell. Relaxing to use.

avis.titre: I love SKIN 1004. I would recommend to buy it!
avis.texte: I've been using the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Toner Pads for a few weeks and absolutely love them! They're super gentle on my skin and help calm irritation and redness. The pads are soaked in a soothing essence that feels refreshing and lightweight. My skin feels balanced, hydrated, and less reactive overall. Great for sensitive or stressed skin!

I use these calming pads after cleansing, especially when my skin feels irritated or inflamed. They're incredibly soothing and instantly take down redness without stinging or burning. The pads are well-saturated, soft, and gentle, making them great even for sensitive skin days. I also love that they help hydrate and prep my skin before the rest of my routine. I haven't experienced any breakouts or irritation while using them. The only downside is I wish the container had a little more product for the price — but overall, I'm very happy with the results.

avis.titre: Very soothing with no harsh scent
avis.texte: I really liked this product. It was very soothing and it had no scent. So it was easy to keep on n forget about it. It didn't irritate my skin and my husband actually enjoyed it very much. I like the tweezers it comes with n the extra bottom lid that keeps the tweezers clean and safe.

I received this product to test in exchange for review. I'm a major fan of this brand and use many of their other products so I was very excited to get to try this one. The pads are very sturdy, but thin, and the product doesn't leave any sticky residue behind. Any leftover product can easily be patted into the skin. I love that it comes with mini tweezers to get the pads, but I did struggle some to only get one pad at a time since they're so thin. I love how hydrated they make my skin feel and it very quickly removes any redness I may have in my face. I'm not sure if it's supposed to be a benefit, but I also notice almost a matte texture to my skin after using which I love. The only con I have is that the pads are a little too big for some parts of my face, especially my forehead. They're big enough that I either have to put them into my hairline or onto my eyebrow and neither of those are great options. I could easily cut them and fix that problem, but it is something to be aware of.

I was so excited to try this product since I have seen similar products like it in the K-beauty world. I have combo eczema prone skin that trends more dry in the winter and oily in the summers. I love having a patch I can place in my eczema flare ups and after using it I can tell my skin is super soft and smooth. Also these stay in place really well; I didn't have to fuss over them sliding down like other sheet masks and patches do. I did notice some dryness in my skin the next day which I don't mind since it will be perfect for when my skin is more oily during the summer. I did receive this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
I tried these pads and like them. They aren't sticky or heavy feeling and give a slight cooling sensation. I will keep using them.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: After cleaning my face I use this product to calm my face before my serums. I loved how clean it makes my face feel.

I love the texture of the pad, it soft and thin but get enough essence to cover my whole face. Using it after cleaning my face and it keeps my facial skin smooth and much moisturize but dry enough to apply next step of my routine skin care
Skin felt hydrated and less red after use. Def adding this to my routing

These Centella Quick Calming Pads are incredibly soothing and hydrating, exactly what my skin needs, especially in the summer. They instantly calm any redness and leave my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized. I love using them daily as a quick pick-me-up, and they've definitely become a staple in my routine. Highly recommend!
This is a must have item in my routine! I My makeup looks flawless and I feel so moisturized. I always put these on before putting on my make up, it's amazing!

Centella is also known as gotu kola, and I love love love herbal/plant based solutions. I use these after cleansing and before moisturizing and they are heavenly. I do one on each cheek and cut one and use that one on my forehead. It's winter here now, but I feel like these will be even better in the summer! They are so soothing and cooling! Big fan, plus very minimal ingredient list......no weird chemicals or unprounounceable things!

avis.titre: I do not think I would personally buy this product
avis.texte: This gave an extremely hydrating glow and overall looked very nice, however it made the parts of my face I put it on breakout, as I have sensitive skin. If someone were to ask for a hydrating glow I would recommend this.

This product is so soothing! I have eczema and sensitive skin. I keep the pads in the refrigerator so they feel even better when I apply them to my skin! It doesn't irritate my face at all. Highly recommend!!

I have been using these calming pads from SKIN1004 for about a week now, and I really, really love them! I have dry skin, especially in the cooler months, but I also have non-painful redness due to my Lupus. I gets what is called a "butterfly rash" across my nose and cheeks. I like to apply these pads over my nose, top of my cheeks and also occasionally on my forehead after cleansing to calm any of that redness. It also just feels amazing to have these on for a few minutes after I wash my face. My skin is dry normally so it feels awesome! They use centella which is absolutely great for the skin! The packaging is lovely, and it comes with a secondary lid where you can store the little tweezers that they include to keep the pads sanitary. No fragrance so no issues with irritation. This is a 10/10 for my skin. LOVE! Gifted by SKIN1004 in exchange for my review, but this is my honest opinion.

I tested this product and I really liked it, it gives a slight cooling effect, after which the skin is soft and pleasant, there is no feeling of stickiness or tightness. Also very convenient packaging and tweezers for easy removal of patches from the packaging.I recommend trying it

I got these as part of a review program. I really liked using these clamping pads after the steam room or a hot bath! Felt like a mini spa day. I love the shape of it and it can easily be used anywhere on face or even body… I tried it on my thighs that often get eczema reactions and it definitely felt good and helped cool it down. I just lotion after and it's all good . I used after waxing my face too. Would recommend!

I started using the Madagascar Centella Quick Calming Pad to calm irritation on my cheek, and it helped almost immediately. The pads are gentle, soothing, and packed with centella essence that reduces redness without feeling sticky. I love that the pads don't feel sticky or heavy. They're thin but sturdy. After a few days, the irritation faded and my skin looked more even and balanced. It's definitely a product I'll keep around for flare-ups or anytime my skin needs quick relief.

These calming pads are super gentle and refreshing. They hydrate, soothe irritation, and leave my skin feeling soft and balanced. Perfect for days when my skin feels sensitive or needs a quick pick-me-up.

I've never used a product like this before so initially I was a little concerned it may break me out but honestly it hasn't. I have the dry skin that somehow fluctuates between very try or you could cook food with the oil on my face. I feel like since I started using this product I'm more in the normal skin range. It helps a lot with irritation I sometimes get from using retin-a. I would highly recommend.

avis.titre: A great easy step for hydration and cleaning.
avis.texte: I really liked this product for calming down redness on my skin especially in the colder months. It was so easy to use and loved that it included a tool to grab the pad and kept it sanitary.

I love these pads! I recieved these as I was going through a minor glycolic acid burn on my face and the pads instantly felt cooling and relieved the irritation. I use these now every other day and cut them up to fit different parts of the face for the calming effect and follow up with the rest of skincare.

I really enjoyed this product much more than I originally thought. I tend to be a stressed and even anxious person and this was the perfect product to use after a long day especially one spent at work! I loved the scent of the product and it wasn't too overwhelming. I tend to be sensitive sometimes to product but I didn't experience any breakouts from using this product overall I definitely recommend.

I loved the way that this absolutely calmed my skin and gave me the best feeling. My skin was breaking out due to it being that time of the month and I was able to use these and immediately comment. I will definitely be buying the product line because of how all this worked.
Leaves my skin feeling great and shiny. Haven't used to too long but excited to see the progress!!!

This is such a beautiful product. I love the spatula and the care the product came with. I've been using it for a week now and it's helped reduce my dry spots due to the colder months. I have a natural glow after using it and I'm noticing my makeup looks so much smoother and brighter.
I used this product before my other skin care products and to my surprise it left me with glow (glass skin ) basically

I received a sample of the Skin1004 toner calming pads for my honest opinion. This was my first time using this brand and it felt so good. The pads are nice luxury to use anytime in the day or night and is convenient quick to apply on. It comes in a tube with about 70 pads. The pads does help calm my skin redness and provide moisture. It also seems to help hydrate my skin in the humid environment. I usually keep in fridge so when I use its nice and cold when applied. The ingredients are also simple and contains centella which helps calm and reduce redness on skin. Definitely would recommend trying these calming pads.

avis.titre: Im definetely going to buy this product once i run out!!
avis.texte: I stuck to the instructions besides leaving it on for a longer period of time to really feel the effects. It helped soothe the redness from my acne after! There is nothing I can say that should be changed or I didn't like about the producct.
After cleansing my face..I apply this product to my t line and let dissolve. It provides a cool sensation but not painful. It helps with my skin irritation due to the harsh weather in November

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product
avis.texte: I must say it really work on my dry and acne face I only used it twice but it really calm the skin

I recently received these calming pads for free in exchange of my own and honest opinions and honestly speaking, I would highly recommend them and plan to purchase more in the future, this product comes with a small set of tweezers for easier application of the pads, which is something that I really appreciated about it, these calming pads only go on the face for 3-5 minutes, which is a super quick application. I find this product to leave my face feeling soft, smooth, revitalized, and it feels great on my skin. I'm definitely impressed!
It left my skin smooth. I have a dry skin and after using this product it helped my skin.

avis.titre: Did have a light break out
avis.texte: So I really like this product, but yes, it did make me break out a little bit, but it just means that my skin really needed the cleaning I do like it It just takes a little bit of time for my skin to get used to for my skin to be clear.
This is my first time trying this product. And I love how it makes my skin. So smooth and hydrated, I highly recommend it.

I keep these pads at work to use when I'm overheated or stressed or just red for no reason. Or, in the case of today, when my barber gave me razor burn on the back of my neck. This product soothes, calms, and reduces redness effectively. It does burn slightly if you have any open cuts (like razor burn), but the sensation goes away quickly.
